blocks.title: Stoichiometry
blocks.text: Stoichiometry chemistry ki woh branch hai jo balanced chemical equation mein reactants aur products ka quantitative (miqdar wala) relationship batati hai.
Mole, Avogadro’s number, molar mass, molar volume aur molar concentration ko jaan kar hum balanced chemical equation se reactants aur products ke darmiyan quantitative relationships bana sakte hain.
